cases.name: Kalin Rachelle Cormier
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Kalin had a passion for her family, especially her girls and granddaughter. She loved watching Hallmark movies, cooking, and keeping her house clean. Kalin was known for her meticulous attention to detail and was a hard worker. In recent months she attended Bible studies with Mimi and Poppie - she enjoyed the fellowship and being a part of it."
cases.narrative: He allegedly followed her and her daughter to local business and shot them in their vehicle.
